immediate_24h_actions: Check that drainage pipes and gutters are clear of debris
Secure loose items near roads and open spaces
Turn off electrical appliances in basements or low‑lying rooms
Keep a bucket and sandbags ready in case of sudden water rise
next_48_72h_actions: Monitor daily discharge updates; watch for spikes above 20 m³/s
If rain exceeds 2 mm in a day, inspect nearby slopes for cracks
Prepare sandbags for vulnerable streets before 2026‑11‑27
Inform neighbours of any water pooling and share resources
agri_livestock_steps: Move stored grains to higher shelves or raised platforms
Secure livestock shelters by checking roof drainage
Check that animal water troughs are not flooded
evacuation_checklist: Identify the nearest high ground or community hall
Pack a bag with water, medicines, documents and a flashlight
Keep mobile phone charged and have emergency numbers ready
Notify family members of meeting point
advisory.confidence_note: Based on current telemetry and short‑term forecast; conditions may change if heavy rain occurs.
